title: Copper Tide
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
The city hums a tune I almost know
Old guitar leaning by the door

[Chorus]
Whisper secrets to the open sky
The rhythm of the wheels keeps time

[Verse 2]
Old guitar leaning by the door
The city hums a tune I almost know

[Chorus]
Whisper secrets to the open sky
The rhythm of the wheels keeps time

[Outro]
The night is ours to keep
